_description: Flow update: Add location_table to Build_Token_Map for Exhibit B
_instructions: 1. Add 3 new actions AFTER Condition_Is_Contract (parallel with Get_Customer, Get_Vendor, Get_Property)
3. Update Build_Token_Map runAfter to include Build_Location_Table

Get_MSA_Locations._description: Query all active locations for the MSA's customer, with location type

Get_MSA_Rates._description: Query all active MSA rates (membership + onboarding by location type)

Build_Location_Table._description: Build HTML table for Exhibit B location list. Matches locations to MSA rates by location type. No Charge locations show $0.00. Monthly total at bottom.
Build_Location_Table.inputs:
@{concat('', join(body('Select_Location_Rows'), ''), '
#TypeAddress 1ADR 2CityStateZIPCost
MONTHLY TOTAL$', formatNumber(outputs('Sum_Monthly_Total'), '0,0.00'), '
')}

Select_Location_Rows._description: Transform each location into an HTML table row. Matches location type to MSA rate for cost column.

inputs.select: @concat('', string(add(indexOf(outputs('Get_MSA_Locations')?['body/value'], item()), 1)), '', coalesce(item()?['dcfg_location_type_id']?['dcfg_name'], ''), '', coalesce(item()?['dcfg_address'], ''), '', coalesce(item()?['dcfg_address_2'], ''), '', coalesce(item()?['dcfg_city'], ''), '', coalesce(item()?['dcfg_state'], ''), '', coalesce(item()?['dcfg_zip'], ''), '', if(equals(item()?['dcfg_is_no_charge'], true), 'No Charge', concat('$', formatNumber(float(coalesce(first(body('Filter_Rate_For_Location'))?['dcfg_membership_rate'], 0)), '0,0.00'))), '')

Filter_Rate_For_Location._description: For each location in Select_Location_Rows, filter MSA rates to find the matching location type rate. Used inside Select_Location_Rows via expression.
Filter_Rate_For_Location._note: THIS ACTION IS REFERENCED INLINE — Power Automate Select cannot reference a separate Filter. Instead, the rate lookup must be done inline in the Select expression. See alternative approach below.
Filter_Rate_For_Location._alternative: Use a preceding 'Apply to each' loop that builds the rows array with rate lookup, or use an inline expression that searches the rates array.

Sum_Monthly_Total._description: Sum all monthly rates for billable (non-no-charge) locations
Sum_Monthly_Total._note: Power Automate doesn't have a native SUM over filtered arrays. Use an Apply to Each with a running total variable, or use inline expression with a Select + sum pattern.

_revised_approach._description: The Select + Filter approach above won't work because Power Automate Select can't call Filter_Rate_For_Location per row. Revised approach uses Apply to Each to build the HTML rows and running total.

Loop_Locations._description: Build HTML rows and sum monthly total. For each location, find matching rate by location type.

inputs.name: varLocationRows
inputs.value: @{concat('', string(add(iterationIndexes('Loop_Locations'), 1)), '', coalesce(items('Loop_Locations')?['dcfg_location_type_id']?['dcfg_name'], ''), '', coalesce(items('Loop_Locations')?['dcfg_address'], ''), '', coalesce(items('Loop_Locations')?['dcfg_address_2'], ''), '', coalesce(items('Loop_Locations')?['dcfg_city'], ''), '', coalesce(items('Loop_Locations')?['dcfg_state'], ''), '', coalesce(items('Loop_Locations')?['dcfg_zip'], ''), '', if(equals(items('Loop_Locations')?['dcfg_is_no_charge'], true), 'No Charge', concat('$', formatNumber(outputs('Set_Rate_Value'), '0,0.00'))), '')}

Build_Location_Table.inputs:
@{concat('', variables('varLocationRows'), '
#TypeAddress 1ADR 2CityStateZIPCost
MONTHLY TOTAL$', formatNumber(variables('varMonthlyTotal'), '0,0.00'), '
')}

build_token_map_addition._description: Add this key to the existing Build_Token_Map Compose inputs object

build_token_map_runafter_addition._description: Add Build_Location_Table to the runAfter dependencies of Build_Token_Map
